title: Total tensor of native flat-term K-flat complexes
statement: Let C be a closed braided monoidal Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian, def-sfb-monoidal-category]. If P and Q are categorically K-flat [def-sfb-preserves-kflat-quasi-iso] unbounded integer complexes and all Pⁿ,Qⁿ are flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], their direct-sum total tensor P⊗Q is categorically K-flat and all its terms are flat.

source.place: Tags 07A2 and 07A4, tensor products of K-flat complexes; flatness by the degreewise coproduct formula.

proof.text: Associativity identifies tensoring with P⊗Q with successive tensoring with P and Q; hence it preserves quasi-isomorphisms in both orders.
In degree n the tensor is the coproduct of Pʳ⊗Qˢ over r+s=n. Flat objects are closed under tensor and coproducts: tensor preserves these colimits and coproducts are exact in a Grothendieck category.

theorem flat_term_kFlat_tensor (P Q : CochainComplex C ℤ)
    (hP : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso C (.up ℤ)).kFlat P)
    (hQ : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso C (.up ℤ)).kFlat Q)
    (hfP : ∀ n, ObjectProperty.flat (P.X n))
    (hfQ : ∀ n, ObjectProperty.flat (Q.X n)) :

      ∀ n, ObjectProperty.flat ((P ⊗ Q).X n)
